objective: Implement deterministic drawdown and risk-of-ruin admission controls using explicit governed thresholds and an explicit ruin-probability input, without introducing defensive scaling, execution or production defaults.
scope: Compute current drawdown in basis points from peak and current equity using conservative ceiling rounding
Consume an explicit validated ruin-probability estimate in parts per million with required model identity
Enforce explicit soft drawdown, hard-stop drawdown and maximum ruin-probability thresholds
Preserve upstream P15-E margin/leverage eligibility as a non-bypassable prerequisite
Emit deterministic WITHIN_LIMITS / DE_RISK_REQUIRED / VETO states
out_of_scope: Broker/exchange order creation, position liquidation or execution
Inventing a production ruin model or probability estimate
tests: Peak and current equity must be finite and positive
Current equity above peak yields zero drawdown
Ruin probability above explicit ceiling emits VETO
Missing ruin model identity fails closed
P15-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P15-F module/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P15-E remains canonical complete and P15-G remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
